name: locally
description: Delegates codebase exploration and routine writing to a local model over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Registers the locally MCP server, and routes large reads and broad searches to explore_task.

baseUrl.title: Endpoint base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint the local model is served from.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name the endpoint serves, such as qwen3-coder:30b.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Sent as a bearer token. Leave empty for a local endpoint that needs no key.

configPath.title: Config file (optional)
configPath.description: Path to a locally.config.json. When set, this file replaces the three values above.
